goal: Add 7 and 5 through the real demo CLI and observe sum 12
scope_rationale: The demo has one executable source file; all output goes outside source scope.
authorization: Execute this local arithmetic fixture only; no network, production data or external services.

requirements.claim: The CLI returns numeric sum 12 for inputs 7 and 5.
requirements.oracle: Independent arithmetic: seven plus five is twelve; compare parsed JSON, not a success label.
requirements.failure_example: Returning the first operand, a constant success message, or sum 13 must fail.
requirements.negative_control_exception: This installation smoke demonstration is supplemented by the shipped harness failure-injection suite; it is not project acceptance.

checks.description: Execute actual CLI with two numeric operands and compare the response.

plan.rationale: One tiny executable; delegation would add overhead without independent work.

delegation.evidence: This demonstration runs as a single local Python process, with no agent orchestration tool.

tasks.title: Verify the integrated CLI behavior
tasks.outcome: The actual executable returns the independently expected numeric result.
outputs: actual process stdout and execution receipt
tasks.acceptance: The process exits successfully and its JSON sum equals twelve.
